title: G-ring invariance under ring equivalence
statement: A ring equivalence R ≃+* S transports the G-ring property from R to S.

proof.text: Transport Noetherianity by isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv. Pull back each prime p to q and use Localization.localRingEquiv. The equivalence maps maximal ideals to maximal ideals. Apply the compatible completion equivalence and transport regularity through the resulting commuting square. This gives each clause of IsGRing unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Definition 07GH and Proposition 07PV; E2 implements the stated isomorphism transport with Mathlib localization and two proved transport lemmas.
